data.text:
Singh Jalpan Grah vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 2 January, 
2024 
Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh
Bench: Saumitra Dayal Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:156-Db
Court No. - 39
Case :- Writ - C No. - 41062 of 2023
Petitioner :- Singh Jalpan Grah
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Jitendra Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
Hon'ble Manjive Shukla,J.
1.  Petitioner's application for grant of license under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 No. 34 of 2006, filed on 13.09.2023, remained pending before respondent no. 3 since 13.09.2023.
2. Without entering into the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent no. 3 to take appropriate decision for grant of license as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of two weeks from the date of communication of certified copy of this order.
